warning.titlePre: Range Rover SV P615 BMW S68 V8 Hot-Vee Pattern
paragraphs: The Range Rover SV (P615) is powered by the BMW S68 twin-turbo V8 — a 4.4-litre unit that shares its hot-vee architecture with the S63 family used in BMW M5, M8, and X5M/X6M models. As with other BMW-sourced performance V8s, the S68 can exhibit the same hot-vee pattern: valve seal wear, coolant line degradation and oil consumption. We replace timing chains, valve seals, and coolant components as standard on every S68 rebuild.
